rationale: The current tool only aggregates failed logins per (ip, user). Finding #001's evidence shows 3 source IPs each making 3 failed attempts against the same account (9 total) producing no alert. This candidate adds a second, independent check: total failed attempts for an account across all source IPs, gated on the attempt coming from 2+ distinct IPs so a single legitimate user mistyping their own password repeatedly from one machine is not flagged. The original per-IP check is kept unchanged so existing single-source brute-force detection does not regress.
